svg.aria-label: Who updates each package. Windows: Velopack checks at launch and every six hours, for the installer and the portable zip. AppImage: AppImageUpdate fetches signed deltas, with automatic downloads off until you opt in. macOS: Sparkle checks the Ed25519 signature before extracting. Flatpak: Orchard 0.3 or newer updates from outside the sandbox; the standalone bundle has no update remote. Arch: the AUR, with whitenoise-linux-bin or a source build. Tarballs for Linux and OpenBSD, and development builds: you download each release. AppImage and macOS update checks are off while a SOCKS5 proxy is configured.

g.text: downloads off until you opt in
